text:
Alex K: Heads-up — planning to roll SDK v2.5.0 tomorrow 16:00 UTC. No breaking proto changes but a couple param name aliases. posting short preflight checklist.
Maria G: Thanks Alex. Is this the one that adds the `timeout_ms` alias for `timeout`?
Alex K: Yep — we keep `timeout` backwards compatible, added `timeout_ms` as an explicit millisecond variant. Migration should be noop for most clients.
Samir: Who's owning the deploy window and pager for canary?
Alex K: Samir can you do canary owner? I'll be primary rollback exec if anything goes wrong.
Samir: I can. I'll watch metrics + error rate dashboards for the 30m canary.
Jin: What % for canary and how long?
Alex K: 5% for 30m, then 25% for 20m, then full. If stable we cutover at +1h.
Lara: Quick smoke checklist I put together: 
- smoke: small generate + streaming check on SDK v2.5
- perf: tail 95th latency for token gen < 200ms extra
- errors: 5xx increase < 0.5%
- telemetry: sampling enabled for new field names
Maria G: Can we add a simple curl test to the smoke? I can add it to the runbook.
Alex K: Good call. Add this to smoke step 1:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"small-test","input":"ping","timeout_ms":5000}'
```
Samir: rollback command if we need to revert to previous image: `kubectl set image deploy/api api=redwood/api:stable-2026-03-10 -n inference`
Jin: Do we need client comms? Any SDK breaking change?
Alex K: Not breaking but there is an alias that might confuse some users. Maria — can you prepare a short note for the SDK release notes + migration blurb? Link to examples.
Maria G: On it. Will publish release note + small code snippet showing both `timeout` and `timeout_ms`.
Lara: Also toggling telemetry sampling for new param. Who flips the flag?
Alex K: I'll flip the feature-flag in LaunchDarkly 10m before canary. Tag: `sdk_timeout_ms_sampling`.
Samir: For monitoring, I'll watch `sdk_requests_total`, `sdk_param_usage{param=\"timeout_ms\"}`, and `api_5xx_rate`. If any threshold crossed I'll notify @pager and start rollback runbook.
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout: SDK v2.5.0 -> canary 2026-03-12T16:00:00Z (5% / 30m) by Samir.
Jin: One more ask — CI has a lint warning about deprecated param in docs. Maria, can you update docs landing page and changelog?
Maria G: Yep. I'll PR changelog and docs page + small note in migration guide.
Alex K: Final: owners list — canary owner Samir, rollback exec Alex, docs Maria, telemetry Lara, oncall (pager) infra-oncall. We'll post status in #eng-platform during rollout.
Samir: I'll post periodic check-ins at 16:05, 16:20, 16:50.
Maria G: Release note draft: "SDK v2.5.0 adds `timeout_ms` alias; fully backward compatible. See migration examples." Will drop PR link in thread when ready.
Alex K: Cool. If nobody objects I'll move this to scheduled. :thumbsup:
Lara: :+1:
Jin: :eyes:
Maria G: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/142 (docs + changelog).
Samir: Starting canary in ~10m. will ping here.
deploy-bot: Canary started (5%). Monitor: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/rollouts/2523456789
Samir: 16:08 - initial smoke passed. no errors.
Samir: 16:25 - 25% rollout started. metrics still stable.
Samir: 16:48 - full rollout initiated.
Alex K: 16:55 - rolling back query: none needed, all good. closing window.
Maria G: Updated release note with final timings.
Alex K: Thanks team — tagging this as complete and adding to release log. :party:
